deterministic_data.verification: Final Workbench assembly is 14/14 ready with zero errors and warnings, including the Factory canonical validator and the persistence check; SqliteStoreRepository carries every one of the 101 StoreRepository operations with the identical signature, plus create_store_schema; the data provider is python_constant_data_v1 from 70_data_provider_closure.json. clock is generated under rules.time_source_policy (single_host_source false) and reviewed as a behavioural module.

modules.summary: Deterministic model module: domain, operation, store-row and value models with their tagged unions, and the StoreRepository port (101 operations, kind interface) whose 101 notes the store-persistence script generates from one row table. Every port operation is carried with the identical signature by SqliteStoreRepository (implementation_obligations). Decision 24 delta reviewed (RunsByStatus.statuses, ShownEffectAttempt).

Deterministic constant module (python_constant_data_v1) emitted from 70_data_provider_closure.json: the release ceilings of A20, token length, header sets, sandbox trap lists, manifest suffix, service-id pattern and the four MCP constants of decision 22. No rules or config address repeats a value.

Canonical JSON (RFC 8785, ±(2^53−1)), content identity per subject with the order-free sorts of A01/A05, the supported schema subset of State 6 decision 2 and the fit order presence, carriage, schema, size are closed by 18 notes; the A01 identity witness is satisfiable from them.

Generated, not a §6.9 backend: rules.time_source_policy names clock as the one reader of time.time_ns and time.monotonic_ns (single_host_source false). The 8 notes carry A19 rules 1-2 (one wall read per kernel_now, epoch microseconds without floating point, monotonic deadlines held in memory only, remaining_ms zero exactly when has_passed) and the replaceable private readers the injected-clock witnesses need.

Emitted from 70_persistence_closure.json (persistence_backend/v3, sqlite_sync_v2, transaction external): SqliteStoreRepository carries all 101 StoreRepository operations with identical signatures plus __init__, and create_store_schema; it imports only models. No note is scoped to it, by design.

Every repository operation the store notes name exists in store_persistence; positions, minted identities, attempt numbers, relations, paging and spool ceilings match State 5 and decision 23. Repaired: files and directories the store creates are private, so the next start's A18 rule 2 check passes on the kernel's own files. Decision 24 delta reviewed (RunsByStatus.statuses, ShownEffectAttempt).

Start checks, the four re-read checks of A16 rule 2 and per-request credential resolution are closed. Repaired from A17 rules 1-2: configuration and secret files are opened component by component without following links, checks and read use one opened file, and a secret file over bounded_text_bytes_max is credential_unresolved (the ceiling is now imported).

A03 isolation, traps, bounds and outcomes are closed. Repaired: the setrlimit process value is set above process_count (owner 2026-10-06; the audit hook enforces process_count), consistent with the next note; failure_detail's ceiling is stated positively and now imported.

Pre-send checks, request building, transport and the A09 rule 5 outcome order are closed. Repaired: a 2xx body over service_response_bytes_max is contract_violation whatever the output ports; value outputs fit with the response ceiling so value_too_large is decided by its own check (State 5); placeholders are judged in name order (A08 rule 5).

Repaired: modal clauses for 13 callables, an equal submission returns the stored record, a port named twice is refused (N07, owner-confirmed), trial refs in port order. Q1 closed by decision 24: rollback to the serving implementation returns it with nothing recorded, before the verdict check.

Manifest reading, the A08 proposal checks in order, acceptance with binding_stale, currency checks and the start check of credential headers are closed; 7 callables were given their modal clause (Factory underspec gate). The Factory slice imports the header-name constants and every model the notes build.

Composition, the nine proof phases and activation are closed against A05/A06 and their witnesses. Repaired: a constant fits its schema as fit_port_value judges it, so a schema outside the State 6 decision 2 subset fits nothing (now imported); 6 callables were given their modal clause.

Approvals, grants, sends under authority, unknown outcomes and recovery are closed against A10/A11. Repaired: records are written with record_change and times taken from kernel_now in a positive clause (clock.kernel_now was missing from imports); a fresh approval after not_applied is judged against the element's latest such attempt (A10 rule 1).

Repaired: every run change is written through record_change with the given actor; all delivered lists of a mapped node are measured before any is delivered. Q2 closed by decision 24: recover_running_runs asks one RunsByStatus naming running, awaiting_approval and pending, answered oldest first in store order.

Repaired: in_set filters are non-empty, at most page_size_max, deduplicated and code-point ordered before page_records (State 5 question 5); a field typed X | None fits when absent or null (witnesses). Open: ShownRecords.effect_attempts is the raw EffectAttempt, whose inputs carry value_id, spool keys and file facts of personal_data values to an agent, against A07 rule 4. Q3 closed by decision 24: an effect attempt is listed as ShownEffectAttempt, its inputs through show_port_refs (A07 rule 4).
